focus: Existing M03 local lighting-plan text: explicit units, axis signs and coordinate references, room-position descriptions, numerical formatting/version metadata, equipment/optics wording, illustrative/calibration assumptions. No M05 or physical-calibration expansion.
review_type: remote pinned-source and test inspection only

checks.result: Source uses 0.3048 meters per foot and POSIX fixed formatting; two-decimal derived values and six-decimal parameter rounding are explicitly disclosed in plainText.

checks.check: Snapshot values, negative-coordinate presentation and aim semantics
checks.result: Validated scene snapshot supplies coordinates and values; explicit manual/follows-subject/undefined/omnidirectional aim text is present. Tests inspect representative fractional and negative coordinates and both units.
Two nonblocking metadata omissions identified in standalone plainText; see findings.

checks.check: Room-position wording and signed subprecision values
checks.result: Room section distinguishes left/near wall coordinates, floor-relative height, horizontal subject distance, floor projection, positive yaw, unmeasured ceiling, wall overhang and height checks. roomDistance uses selected-unit bounds for nonzero magnitudes below 0.000001 and preserves negative-side meaning.
checks.execution: static inspection; underlying room transform and room tests not reviewed

checks.result: Text carries light number/name and kind.title; rectangle dimensions and authored roll are conditional, output uses cd/K/mm and relative stops. Source clearly states ideal uncalibrated parameters and absent reference images; room limitations distinguish displayed precision from measurement accuracy and require physical verification of complete fixtures.
checks.execution: static inspection; EmitterKind.title implementation not inspected

findings.case: Export a standalone plain-text lighting plan for any validated scene.
findings.title: Plain-text export omits report and scene versions
findings.evidence: reportVersion exists, but plainText constructs its complete output without reportVersion or scene schema/version metadata. The product describes version-bearing exported plans, and architecture specifically records PDF version footers.
findings.impact: A saved/shared text plan cannot identify the report format or scene schema it describes, weakening interpretation and reproduction across later format/schema changes.
findings.recommendation: Include explicit report and scene-version metadata in the existing text header/footer and assert its presence in LightingPlanTests. This is a current text-export metadata correction, not an M05 acceptance claim.

findings.case: Export plain text without a room, using a rig whose lights occupy different positive and negative Z coordinates, and recreate it from the text alone.
findings.title: Standalone coordinate header leaves X/Z direction convention unspecified
findings.evidence: plainText identifies XYZ, selected units and Y elevation only. The diagram source declares +X right/+Z down; architecture defines +X right/+Y up/+Z toward the initial default camera. Neither convention is carried into standalone text.
findings.impact: The text preserves signed values but requires external knowledge to interpret X/Z orientation; readers can mirror or reverse a setup despite copying its numbers correctly.
findings.recommendation: State the authored world coordinate convention in the text, with the initial/default-camera qualification for +Z. Keep the room section's separately defined wall-relative frame explicit. Add a no-room text assertion for the convention.

limitations: Host/runtime unavailable per assignment: no scripts, Swift tests, Apple builds, UI tests, PDF render/share/open checks, or physical validation were executed.
Remote reads were pinned to the supplied base SHA; local status, current branch/HEAD, uncommitted work, recent commits and live CI were not independently inspected.
Source/test review is not a passing M03 acceptance run or verification of historical handoff claims.

RoomPlacementPlan/RoomVerticalClearance implementations and EmitterKind.title definitions were outside the narrow inspected paths; their calculations/strings are not independently validated by this report.
PDF layout and workflow behavior are assigned to separate workers. No source, tree, commit, branch or ref was changed.
conclusion: No P0/P1 finding in the inspected text model. Two nonblocking P2 standalone-text metadata omissions; units, rounding disclosure, conditional optics/aim text and calibration limitations are internally coherent in the inspected source.
